scenes.description: Standing beside a Wooden Wall Height Chart to Measure Height
Comparing a Long Green Ruler with a Short Pencil on the Desk
Balancing Heavy and Light Fruit Toys on a Colorful Scale

character_line.en: Stand against the wall height chart! Wow, you grew taller! How tall are you?
character_line.zh: 靠在牆壁的身高尺站好！哇，你長高了！你有多高呢？

options.en: I am tall! I am one hundred and twenty centimeters!
options.zh: 我好高喔！我有一百二十公分！

options.hint: 看看身高尺上的刻度，自信地說「I am tall!」喔！
告訴 Benny 你量出來的身高公分數吧！

character_line.en: You are growing so fast! Am I taller or shorter than you?
character_line.zh: 你長得好快喔！那我比你高還是比你矮呢？

options.en: I am taller, and you are shorter, cute Benny!
options.zh: 我比你高，而你比較矮，可愛的 Benny！

options.hint: 比較兩人的身高，說「I am taller, and you are shorter」喔！
告訴 Benny 你比小熊高，小熊比較嬌小可愛喔！

character_line.en: Let's check our desk! Look at this ruler and this tiny pencil! How are they different?
character_line.zh: 我們來看看書桌！看這把尺和這支小鉛筆！它們有什麼不同呢？

options.en: The green ruler is long, and the pencil is short!
options.zh: 綠色的尺很長，而鉛筆短短的！

options.hint: 比較長短，說「ruler is long, pencil is short」喔！
告訴 Benny 直尺很長，而鉛筆短短的喔！

character_line.en: Look at the school textbook and the notebook! Which one is thicker?
character_line.zh: 看學校教科書和作業本！哪一本比較厚呢？

options.en: The science book is thick, and the notebook is thin!
options.zh: 自然課本很厚，而作業筆記本很薄！

options.hint: 比較厚度，說「book is thick, notebook is thin」喔！
摸摸看百科書很厚，而小筆記本很薄喔！

character_line.en: Here is our toy scale! We put a big watermelon toy on one side and a tiny strawberry on the other! What happens?
character_line.zh: 這是我們的玩具天秤！我們一邊放個大西瓜玩具、另一邊放顆小草莓！會發生什麼事呢？

options.en: The big watermelon is heavy, and the strawberry is light!
options.zh: 大西瓜很重，而小草莓輕輕的！

options.hint: 比較重量，大西瓜重「heavy」、小草莓輕「light」喔！
天秤沉下去那邊比較重，翹起來那邊比較輕喔！

character_line.en: Measuring and comparing things is so exciting! Did you learn a lot today?
character_line.zh: 測量和比較東西真是太好玩了！你今天學到很多嗎？

options.en: Yes! Measuring sizes and weights is so much fun!
options.zh: 是的！測量尺寸和重量真是太有趣了！

options.hint: 開心回答測量尺寸與重量非常有趣「so much fun」喔！
告訴 Benny 你今天學會了比較長短大小與輕重吧！
